findings.description: Nit: In contracts/schemas/trust-posture.schema.json at line 20, the field description for gates still reads 'Keys are restricted to the eight enumerated gates', but properties under gates were expanded in task 1.3 to include roadmap_approval (bringing the total to nine).
findings.resolution: Update the description of gates in contracts/schemas/trust-posture.schema.json to state 'the nine enumerated gates'.

findings.description: Nit: In contracts/schemas/gate-decision.schema.json (line 3) and contracts/schemas/gate-request.schema.json (line 3), the $id URI fields contain 'https://agentic-coding-tools/openspec/changes/encode-autopilot-gates-and-goal-gate-in-code/contracts/events/...', referencing the parent change ID encode-autopilot-gates-and-goal-gate-in-code rather than the current change ID or canonical schema URI.
findings.resolution: Update $id URIs in contracts/schemas/gate-decision.schema.json and gate-request.schema.json to reference the current change path or canonical schema URI.
